items.title: Dave Bailey and John McNeil Interview, 1959-10-25
items.q: The Jewmaker was all killing by the ladies' friends.

ctx.x: Lee Collins used to play with you? Sure. We used to play with my brother at the offensive band. Oh yeah. Sure. I said Lee Collins was getting killed down Lee County Hall. I'm sure of that. The Jewmaker was all killing by the ladies' friends. That sounds like the truth. I'm telling the truth. Look. You know what's happened? Another folks played at this place, you know? And he went down there and got to dancing with the Jewmaker. The ladies' friends. The Jewmaker's giving her a dance. That's a wild lady. Got to…
